name: oralis-cloud
description: Oralis Cloud — plataforma SaaS para clínicas odontológicas (monólito modular).

scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @oralis/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @oralis/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @oralis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @oralis/api && npm run typecheck -w @oralis/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @oralis/shared && npm test -w @oralis/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @oralis/api && npm run build -w @oralis/web
scripts.test:ui: node scripts/test-clinical-editor.cjs && node scripts/test-operational-ui.cjs && node scripts/test-workspace-ui.cjs
